description: A security assessment plan to periodically evaluate security controls is not developed or documented. This signal indicates that security control effectiveness may not be systematically verified.
applicability: Applicable to all organizational security assessment activities. Includes assessment methodology, scope, frequency, and documentation requirements.

metadata.detection_notes: Detected through security assessment documentation review, methodology verification, and assessment schedule assessment.

sources.title: 32 CFR Part 170 - Cybersecurity Maturity Model Certification Program
